steps.speaker: Mira
steps.title: Welcome to Thornhaven!
steps.body:
Well met, Shopkeeper! I'm Mira, innkeeper of the Wanderer's Rest. The Crown said you'd be coming — and not a moment too soon.

Corruption creeps in from the forest. Twisted roots, blighted beasts, things that shouldn't exist. We have brave souls willing to fight, but they need supplies. Gear. Potions. That's where you come in.

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.title: Recruit Your First Heroes
steps.body:
First things first — you'll need a party. The town council has put up 400 gold as an investment in your venture. Use it to recruit heroes at the Inn — each one has a race and class that shape how they fight.

After recruiting, use the Add to Party button to assign them to your active party. Pick at least two to start — a Defender to soak hits and a Striker to deal damage is a solid foundation.

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.title: The Inn & Resting Heroes
steps.body:
Each region has its own Inn — heroes not in your active party rest at the Inn where they were recruited. While your party is off fighting, resting heroes earn 25% of the experience your party gains. They won't fall behind completely.

Upgrade the Inn to increase bench capacity and attract more experienced recruits with better starting gear. For now, let's get your first party together.
